commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Victor Garcia has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Booking. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) receives a caution from the referee.
90+7' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Victor Garcia ignores the protests.
90+3' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+1' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
90+1' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
89' Raul Moro (Osasuna) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
87' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) sends a long ball in, but Sergio Herrera comfortably gathers the ball.
84' Substitution. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) in, Jorge Herrando out.
84' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) has come on for Jon Moncayola.
81' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) replaces Yuri Berchiche.
80' The game is interrupted now, Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aimar Oroz departs the field of play to be replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
77' What a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Unai Simon dived superbly to deny Ante Budimir (Osasuna), whose header was directed to the bottom right corner.
76' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
75' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Dani Vivian comes onto the pitch to replace him.
73' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Osasuna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
71' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Ruben Garcia is replaced by Raul Moro (Osasuna).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) will replace Lucas Torro.
71' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
70' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
69' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
65' The game has come to an end for Alex Berenguer. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
65' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) replacing Nico Williams.
65' Substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).

64' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
63' The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
63' Javi Galan (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
61' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
60' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
57' Unai Simon anticipates the direction of the penalty by Ante Budimir (Osasuna). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
57' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
56' It’s a PENALTY to Osasuna after the VAR review!

55' Play continues despite the shouts by some Ath Bilbao players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Victor Garcia interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
54' Surely that's handball by one of the Ath Bilbao players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
54' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
53' The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
53' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
52' The attendance for today's match is 47500.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' The whistle blows and Victor Garcia starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' An attempted cross from Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) is cleared.
45+1' Javi Galan (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
38' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
32' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Victor Garcia saw the whole situation.
28' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
23' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
22' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Sergio Herrera makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal.
14' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
10' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) for a tough tackle.
10' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
10' The ball is cleared after Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
6' The Ath Bilbao players are stunned as referee Victor Garcia changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
5' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Ath Bilbao as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
5' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Penalty awarded! Ath Bilbao will take a penalty kick.
4' The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
4' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
2' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Victor Garcia.
